CreateAppGroup.description_en: Creates an application group and returns the AppKey

CreateJob.description_en: Creates a job and returns the job ID

CreateWorkflow.description_en: Creates a workflow. The workflow is disabled by default. After you update the directed acyclic graph (DAG), you must manually start the workflow or start it by calling an API operation. Only the Professional Edition supports this feature
CreateWorkflow.description_zh: 创建工作流，默认禁用状态，更新完DAG后，需要手动或者通过API启动用工作流，只有专业版才支持

DescribeRegions.description_en: Returns the list of available regions

ExecuteJob.description_en: Triggers a job to run immediately
ExecuteJob.description_zh: 触发一次任务立即运行

ExecuteWorkflow.description_en: Triggers an immediate run of a workflow
ExecuteWorkflow.description_zh: 触发一次工作流立即运行

GetJobInfo.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified job, which is typically used to update the job
GetJobInfo.description_zh: 获取指定Jobid任务详情，通常用来更新任务

GetJobInstance.description_en: Retrieves the details of a task instance, including its status and progress
GetJobInstance.description_zh: 返回任务实例的信息，可以查看任务实例的状态和进度

GetJobInstanceList.description_en: Retrieves the execution history of a job filtered by keywords
GetJobInstanceList.description_zh: 根据关键字过滤，返回任务执行的历史记录

GetLog.description_en: Queries the execution logs of a job. This feature is available only in the Professional Edition
GetLog.description_zh: 通过该API可以查询任务的运行日志，需要开通专业版才支持

GetOverview.description_en: Retrieves the overview data of task scheduling for Professional Edition applications
GetOverview.description_zh: 获取专业版应用任务调度概览数据信息

GetWorkerList.description_en: Retrieves the list of workers connected to a specified application
GetWorkerList.description_zh: 获取接入某个应用的worker列表

GetWorkflowInstance.description_en: Queries the details of a specified workflow instance, including the instance status, dependencies, and the status of each node instance. This operation is supported only for Professional Edition applications
GetWorkflowInstance.description_zh: 获取指定工作流实例的详情，包含实例状态，依赖关系，每个任务实例的状态等。专业版应用才支持

GrantPermission.description_en: Grants authorization to a specified group

ListJobScriptHistory.description_zh: 获取任务脚本历史列表

ListWorkFlows.description_en: Retrieves a list of workflow information

ListWorkflowInstance.description_en: Retrieves the historical execution records of a workflow. This feature is supported only in Professional Edition
ListWorkflowInstance.description_zh: 获取工作流的历史执行记录，只有专业版才支持

ReadSchedulerxDesignateDetail.description_en: Retrieves the details of machines specified for a task
ReadSchedulerxDesignateDetail.description_zh: 获取任务指定的机器详细信息

ReadSchedulerxDesignateInfo.description_en: Retrieves the basic information of a specified machine
ReadSchedulerxDesignateInfo.description_zh: 获取指定的机器基本信息

RerunJob.description_en: Reruns historical data of a node. This operation is supported only by the professional edition
RerunJob.description_zh: 重跑任务的历史数据，只有专业版才支持

RetryJobInstance.description_en: Reruns a node instance in the failed or successful state. Only the professional edition supports this operation
RetryJobInstance.description_zh: 重跑失败或者成功状态的任务实例，只有专业版才支持

RevokePermission.description_en: Revokes the permissions of a specified Alibaba Cloud RAM user
RevokePermission.description_zh: 取消指定阿里云子账号的权限

SetJobInstanceSuccess.description_en: Forcibly sets the node instance status to successful. Only DAS Professional Edition supports this operation
SetJobInstanceSuccess.description_zh: 强制设置任务实例状态为成功状态，只有专业版才支持

SetWfInstanceSuccess.description_en: Forcibly sets the workflow instance status to the success state. Only the professional edition supports this operation
SetWfInstanceSuccess.description_zh: 强制设置工作流实例状态为成功状态，只有专业版才支持

StopInstance.description_zh: 终止某次正在运行的实例

UpdateJob.description_en: Updates the configuration of a job. By default, you must first call the operation to query the job and find the corresponding fields to modify
UpdateJob.description_zh: 更新任务配置信息。默认先调用获取任务找到对应字段进行修改

UpdateJobScript.description_en: Updates the execution script of a node

UpdateWorkflow.description_en: Updates the basic information of a workflow. Only the Professional Edition supports this operation
UpdateWorkflow.description_zh: 更新工作流的基本信息，只有专业版才支持

UpdateWorkflowDag.description_en: Updates the nodes and dependencies of a workflow. Only Professional Edition applications support this operation
UpdateWorkflowDag.description_zh: 更新工作流的节点及依赖关系，专业版应用才支持
